zh: 丹麦技术大学（Technical University of Denmark，简称 DTU）成立于1829年，是丹麦最古老的技术大学，也是北欧地区顶尖的理工科大学之一。学校位于哥本哈根北部的孔恩斯灵比，以其在工程技术、自然科学和可持续技术领域的创新研究而闻名。DTU在风力发电、能源技术、生物技术、信息技术等前沿领域处于国际领先地位。
en: Technical University of Denmark (DTU) was founded in 1829

contact: making it Denmark's oldest technical university and one of the top technical universities in Northern Europe. Located in Kongens Lyngby north of Copenhagen

address.zh: the university is renowned for its innovative research in engineering
